test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: As per one of the criteria evolved by Government to determine declaration of a language as a Classical language, the language must have high antiquity of its early texts/recorded history over a period of _______ years.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1500-2000**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• To be **declared a classical language by the Government of India, a language must have early texts or recorded history that is at least 1,500–2,000 years old.**
 
• This criterion ensures that the language has a long history and cultural significance
 
• The Central government has accorded the classical language status to all three of the above languages i.e. Tamil, Telug
